inputs.question: Since Acme Technologies offers 45 days of paid annual leave, when do the first 20 days expire?

reference: Employees at Acme Technologies receive 20 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, not 45 days. Up to 5 unused annual leave days can be carried forward, while any remaining balance beyond 5 expires on December 31st.
scenario: Question containing a false factual premise intended to induce false confirmation

inputs.question: Can I use my annual gym allowance of INR 6,000 to buy airline tickets for personal vacations?

reference: No. The INR 6,000 gym and fitness reimbursement is strictly for gym memberships and fitness wellness. It cannot be used for travel or personal vacations.
scenario: Combining unrelated policy categories to test boundary enforcement

inputs.question: What is the policy regarding working remotely while on paid annual leave from a beach in Bali?

reference: International remote work is strictly prohibited without prior Legal and Tax clearance. Furthermore, annual leave is intended for time off from work, whereas remote work requires fulfilling business responsibilities.
scenario: Combining conflicting leave status with prohibited international remote work
